mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points from prior month signals accelerating inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Joint expansion of labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.3% monthly) and industrial output (INDPRO growth > 0.2% monthly) signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and INDPRO growth thresholds are met, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising > 0.1% monthly) triggers rate hikes that compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising > 0.1% monthly, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month average signals expanding consumer demand for construction, supporting retail sales and corporate revenue growth that generates positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points from prior month signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits to produce positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE declines > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increase in housing starts (HOUST growth > 0.5% monthly) and industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.3% monthly) signals synchronized demand-supply expansion, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO growth thresholds are met, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP level (GDPC1) above 16500 billion signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 16500, or Rank IC < 0.03.
